new_jobs.title: Service Supply Chain Strategic Partner Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Description -** **HP Service Supply Chain** organization is looking for a **Strategic Partner Manager** to contribute to the design and implementation of its Partner Strategy and manage the directly relationship and business model with strategic partners going forward. This role combines unique mastery and recognized authority on relevant subject matter knowledge including technologies, theories and techniques. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of innovative principles, ideas and executive process management, provide highly innovative solutions to supplier/partner engagement, performance and transformation including the leverage of automation and AI, and lead large, cross-division functional teams or projects that affect the organization's long-term goals and objectives. May participate in cross-division, multi-function teams, routinely exercises independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and criteria for achieving objectives, and develop strategy and sets functional policy and direction. **Responsibilities** * Independently structures analytical approaches and develops service partner strategies by applying advanced, in-depth supply chain and industry knowledge. * Leverage AI tools and process improvement methodologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness. * Interprets data to create new processes, strategies, and tools to be used for supply chain business objectives and improve partner operational performance. * Leads large, cross- functional project teams, providing mentoring and guidance in support of building and maintaining the strategic supplier/partner roadmap. * Consults with business executives (internally and externally) on a wide range of high-level supply chain issues, including risk management and new growth opportunities. * Drives process improvements, cost savings through effective negotiations with partners and stakeholders. * Guide complex negotiations with partners and suppliers regarding commercial terms, pricing structures, service models, and performance commitments **Education & Experience Recommended** * Four-year or Graduate Degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations management, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. * Typically has 10+ years of work experience, preferably in supply chain, operations, and strategic partner management, or related strategic business functions. * Experience participating in large-scale transformation, automation, digitalization, or AI-enabled business initiatives. * Demonstrated success coordinating complex cross-functional programs in a global business environment. **Knowledge & Skills** * Demonstrated experience managing strategic supplier or partner relationships, including commercial negotiations and executive stakeholder engagement. * Knowledge and experience in field service delivery and reverse supply chain a plus. * Strong business acumen with targeted knowledge and experience in procurement, planning, warehousing and logistics including reverse supply chain flows. * Advanced analytical and problem solving skills with proven track record in financial modeling and business case creation. * Extensive knowledge of and ability to manage complex financial analysis and modeling. * Advanced written and verbal communication, presentation, stakeholder communication and persuasion skills; mastery in English and local language. * Proven ability to communicate effectively and influence at executive (VP+) level. * Advanced team and project management skills, including project structuring and managing multiple work streams independently. **Cross-Org Skills** * Effective Communication * Results Orientation * Learning Agility * Digital Fluency * Customer Centricity **Impact & Scope** Impacts large functions and leads large, cross-division functional teams or projects. **Complexity** Provides highly innovative solutions to complex problems within established policy. **Disclaimer** This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. **Job -** Supply Chain & Operations **Schedule -** Full time **Shift -** No shift premium (Taiwan) **Travel -** 25% **Relocation -** No **Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) -** HP, Inc. provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and prospective employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, age, disability, or status as a protected veteran, marital status, familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic predisposition or carrier status, uniformed service status, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by applicable national, federal, state, and local law(s). Please be assured that you will not be subject to any adverse treatment if you choose to disclose the information requested. This information is provided voluntarily. The information obtained will be kept in strict confidence. For more information, review HP’s EEO Policy or read about your rights as an applicant under the law here: “Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal"

new_jobs.title: Asset Management - Taiwan CAO Office - Associate
new_jobs.jd: **Job Description** The Taiwan Asset Management (AM) Chief Administrative Officer Office (CAO Office) is responsible to execute high priority initiatives and provide governance over the Taiwan AM business to ensure that the firmwide / regulatory requirements are fulfilled, and that business is operating effectively and efficiently. As an Associate in the Asset Management CAO Office, you are required to build close partnership with front, middle, back offices as well as control functions on efforts which are aligned to the business's strategic goals. You will report to Taiwan AM CAO. You will be involved in regional or global projects that impact Taiwan AM business, playing an active role in ensuring local requirements and critical factors are well embedded into the overall project scoping and implementation, while ensuring a win-win outcome and overall success of those projects. You are also responsible to execute administrative-level tasks. We are looking for an Associate who is self-motivated, can plan and execute projects strategically, efficiently and innovatively. You are required to equip with proficient English writing and speaking skills, a strong sense of confidentiality, and a can-do mindset. Job responsibilities * Support Taiwan AM CAO to monitor and remediate risks that have impact to AM business. * Own the preparation and production of regular reports to relevant governance bodies. * Work with regional/global stakeholders to execute key business priorities. * Work with various stakeholders to maintain and update procedures and policies when appropriate. * Proactively identify and escalate critical issues with a focus on resolution. * Manage several efforts simultaneously across a range of functions, business and organizational units. * Work with business stakeholders to help define and drive strategy and execution. * Identify and bring together the right resources, content experts and decision makers to meet goals. * Manage effective and efficient communication of projects with senior management and impacted stakeholders. * Support and conduct clear analysis, logical structuring, and creative problem solving on critical issues; assess risks, costs, and benefits of alternative decisions and approaches. * Proactively identify and address risks and opportunities relating to the business as a whole or specific projects; proactively propose innovative and actionable solutions to solve business problems and improve operating model. **Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills** * At least 5 years of relevant experience (e.g., strategy consulting, banking, program management) * Understanding of business and management functions in local Taiwan Asset Management and/or related financial services industries * Able to work in a fast paced, deadline driven environment * Comfort with ambiguity and dynamically shifting priorities, timelines, and demands * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Strong analytical and problem solving skills * Equip with high risk & control mindset * Ability to network with internal stakeholder community to foster positive and proactive collaboration * Highly proficient in Microsoft (including Word, PowerPoint and Excel) **ABOUT US** J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation. **About The Team** J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

new_jobs.title: AVP/ Analyst, Business Planning & Process, Investment Products & Advisory, Consumer Banking Group
new_jobs.jd: **About The Role** We are looking for a proactive and analytical professional to join the Business Planning & Process team within Investment Products and Advisory (IP&A). This role is responsible for supporting business planning, budgeting, performance management, and strategic initiatives for the Wealth Management business. Working closely with senior stakeholders, you will provide business insights, performance analysis, and management reporting that support growth and strategic decision-making. **Job Purpose** Support Wealth Management business growth through effective business planning, budgeting, forecasting, performance monitoring, and strategic analysis. The role will contribute to business management initiatives and support the development of strategies that enhance business performance and customer outcomes. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the annual budgeting and business planning process for the Wealth Management business. * Prepare business review reports, management presentations, and meeting materials for senior management. * Produce regular business forecasts and performance analysis, including bottom-up forecasting and product performance reviews. * Monitor key business metrics and management reports to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. * Generate actionable insights to support strategic planning and business growth initiatives. * Support business management planning and execution across Investment Products and Advisory. * Participate in and support key Consumer Banking Group projects and transformation initiatives. * Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and internal governance standards. **Our Ideal Candidate** **Qualifications & Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Statistics, or a related discipline. * Minimum 3 years of experience in banking, wealth management, business planning, financial analysis, or related functions. * Sound understanding of investment products, wealth management business models, and sales processes. * Professional qualifications such as MBA, CFA, CFP, or equivalent certifications are advantageous. **Skills & Competencies** * Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights. * Excellent communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and project management skills. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and functions. * Flexible, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. * Up-to-date knowledge of financial markets, investment products, and relevant regulations. * Strong proficiency in data analysis and business performance management. **Why Join Us?** This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with business leaders in Wealth Management and Investment Products & Advisory, influencing strategic decision-making through data-driven insights, business planning, and performance management. You will gain broad exposure across budgeting, forecasting, product analytics, business strategy, and cross-functional projects while contributing directly to the growth of the franchise. **Location:** Honhui A-12F **Job:** COO Office/Business Mgt & Support **Schedule:** Regular **Employee Status:** Full time

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management (Retail Instock Analytics, Taiwan)
new_jobs.jd: **Company Introduction** Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Overseas” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” **Role Overview** As a Senior Manager, Program Management within Retail Instock Analytics, you will drive strategic initiatives that improve product availability, inventory efficiency, and business performance across Coupang Taiwan. You will work closely with Retail, Supply Chain, Product, Operations, and Tech stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and drive data-driven decision making. This role combines business analytics, program leadership, and stakeholder management to deliver measurable business impact at scale. **What You Will Do** * Lead cross-functional programs to improve inventory availability and operational performance. * Drive business decisions through analytics, forecasting, and performance insights. * Partner with Retail, Supply Chain, Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to solve complex business problems. * Develop and monitor key business metrics, reporting frameworks, and operational mechanisms. * Translate business challenges into actionable recommendations and execution plans. * Influence stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels. * Drive scalable process improvements and operational excellence initiatives. **Basic Qualifications** * 8+ years of experience in Program Management, Business Analytics, Business Intelligence, Retail Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics, Consulting, Strategy, or related fields. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data into business insights. * Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets. * Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in Retail, E-commerce, Marketplace, Supply Chain, or Logistics environments. * Experience in forecasting, inventory management, optimization, or operational analytics. * Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI tools. * Python or advanced analytics experience is a plus. **Recruitment Process** * Application Review - new_jobs.title: 客戶經營暨數位通路經理
new_jobs.company: PCA Life Assurance Co Ltd. (保誠人壽)
new_jobs.jd: Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed. **主要職能：客戶經營、名單管理與專案推動，以提升跨售效能及客戶價值** **one. 客戶經營與跨售策略：** * 制定客戶經營、跨售及名單行銷策略，依營運目標規劃重點客群、行銷主題與推動方案。 * 規劃既有客戶經營機制，包含 CRM、回購、交叉銷售、會員及忠誠度經營等。 **two. 名單策略與管理** * 建立名單取得、篩選、分配、使用、追蹤及回饋機制，提升名單使用效率及轉換成效。 * 與業務前線及合作單位協作，推動名單型行銷及銷售專案。 **3. 行銷與客戶經營專案管理** * 專案前期：依業務目標及客戶需求進行需求分析，定義專案目標、Target Audience、KPI、執行策略、時程、資源需求及跨部門分工。 * 專案中期：負責專案執行與進度管理，協調業務前線及跨部門單位，持續追蹤執行進度、名單運用、客戶反應及關鍵指標，並適時調整執行方式。 * 專案後期：依 KPI 進行成效分析及專案檢討，分析活動觸及、名單轉換、跨售及業務成果，歸納關鍵成功因素與改善機會。 * 持續優化：將分析結果及經驗回饋至後續客群選擇、名單策略、活動機制及執行流程，建立持續優化的 closed-loop management。 **4. 客戶活動與經營機制** * 規劃及執行推薦制、MGM、會員經營、忠誠度等客戶經營方案。 * 依不同客群與業務需求規劃行銷活動及銷售機會，強化客戶互動、回購及跨售效能。 **5. 數據分析與成效優化** * 建立及追蹤客戶經營、名單運用、行銷活動與專案執行之核心 KPI。 * 透過數據分析辨識問題與機會，提出具體優化方案，持續改善客群、名單、活動及跨售策略。 **6. AI 與數位工具應用** * 善用 AI、數據分析及數位工具，提升客戶洞察、名單分析、行銷企劃、專案執行與營運效率。 **次要職能：** **商品策略規劃、新商品發想與銷售分析** **商品行銷活動專案推動與行政支援** * 熟悉保險商品，支援保險商品之策略規劃與企劃推動，包含新商品發想、商品定位與銷售策略規劃，定期進行競爭市場與同業商品分析，盤點市場缺口與商品機會。 * 負責既有商品銷售表現之分析，與商品策略要求，並提出商品結構或策略調整建議。 * 新商品上線時，需規劃核心銷售賣點、銷售主軸與通路推廣策略，進行商品導入與推廣。 * 支援商品相關專案之推動與營運執行，包含商品上架流程協助與跨部門溝通、商品系統維護。 * 因應法令或管理需求進行商品異動與內容調整、配合查核需求進行相關資料與網頁內容更新。 * 配合直效行銷通路商品上下架與相關文件維護等行政作業。 **Prudential is an equal opportunity employer.** We provide equality of opportunity of benefits for all who apply and who perform work for our organisation irrespective of sex, race, age, ethnic origin, educational, social and cultural background, marital status, pregnancy and maternity, religion or belief, disability or part-time / fixed-term work, or any other status protected by applicable law. We encourage the same standards from our recruitment and third-party suppliers taking into account the context of grade, job and location. We also allow for reasonable adjustments to support people with individual physical or mental health requirements.

new_jobs.title: SAP 技術工程師 (PP/MM/SD/QM模組)
new_jobs.location: Linkou District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: Position Impact: 本職位為 SAP 開發工程師，主要負責 SAP 系統相關專案的導入、優化與維運支援。應徵者需具備深入的企業業務流程知識，熟稔 SAP 功能邏輯，並能有效整合其他相關模組之運作。 Responsibility: * 流程分析與優化：針對企業內一個或多個核心功能領域（如：生產規劃 PP、物料管理 MM、銷售與分銷 SD 等），提供業務分析與流程重塑之專業建議，特別著重於 SAP 系統功能與流程的分析與優化。 * 模組效益推廣：溝通並推廣 SAP 系統於 PP、MM、SD、QM 等模組的應用情境、系統功能與最佳實踐方案。 * 系統客制化配置：根據業務需求與流程設計，進行 SAP 系統功能客製化與參數設定。 * 規格書撰寫：撰寫與準備報表之系統功能規格書。 * 熟悉生產作業：掌握生產作業流程，並熟悉既有的業務優先順序與執行程序。 * 跨團隊協作：建立良好的業務合作關係，與其他 IT 團隊緊密配合，確保專案順利導入與後續維運支援。 * 專案進度管控：監控並向管理層呈報專案進度，主動預判並識別影響專案目標的潛在風險，並提出與執行有效的改善措施。 Requirements: * 學歷要求：企業管理、資訊工程、軟體工程、資訊管理或相關專業大學（含）以上學歷佳。 * 核心模組經驗：具備至少 3 年以上擔任 SAP 後勤模組（SD or PP or QM）IT Owner / 模組負責人的實務經驗。 * 系統配置能力：具備扎實的SAP後勤模組 Configuration（系統設定）及功能知識。 * ABAP 開發概念與客製經驗：具備扎實的ABAP開發能力/理解，包含BAPI、Enhancements（系統擴充）及 User Exits 之應用與調用。 * IMG 操作：運用 IMG進行 SAP 客製化與參數設定之經驗加分。 * 邏輯與問題解決：具備強大的邏輯分析與問題解決能力，並能將複雜的業務流程進行系統化概念構思。 * 程式設計邏輯：理解程式設計原理，並具備結構化設計、開發與系統導入之經驗。

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect Program Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Description -** **Job Summary** The Solution Architect Program Manager is responsible for driving advanced technology solutions from early concept through architecture definition, proof of concept, productization planning, system integration, validation, and launch readiness. This role combines deep technical capability with disciplined program execution to ensure that innovative concepts are translated into clear scope, committed deliverables, product milestones, and launch timelines. This position requires strong solution architecture judgment, structured planning, and cross-functional leadership across engineering, product, hardware, firmware, software, validation, security, operations, and external partners. The role owns the bridge between concept feasibility and production execution by defining requirements, aligning stakeholders, managing schedules, resolving technical dependencies, tracking risks, and maintaining readiness documentation required to deliver solutions on product milestones and market launch commitments. **Responsibilities** * Drive end-to-end solution programs from concept exploration, business and technical feasibility, architecture definition, POC execution, productization planning, system integration, validation, and launch readiness. * Translate ambiguous innovation concepts into clear solution scope, use cases, requirements, architecture assumptions, success criteria, milestones, resource needs, and execution plans. * Own integrated schedules that align engineering deliverables with product development checkpoints, POR decisions, validation gates, manufacturing readiness, and launch timeline commitments. * Partner closely with product management, system architecture, hardware, firmware, software, security, validation, operations, and external suppliers to manage dependencies and secure delivery commitments. * Lead architecture and technical tradeoff discussions to ensure solution designs are scalable, secure, manufacturable, supportable, and aligned with product roadmap priorities. * Define and maintain program artifacts, including functional requirements, interface assumptions, system-state definitions, delivery plans, issue logs, risk registers, decision records, validation plans, and readiness checklists. * Drive issue triage, dependency closure, technical decision-making, mitigation planning, fallback options, and escalation paths to keep programs on schedule. * Review program deliverables for alignment with solution intent, architecture requirements, product milestone criteria, quality expectations, security standards, and production-readiness needs. * Communicate program status, risks, tradeoffs, decision asks, recovery plans, and launch readiness clearly to engineering leaders, product stakeholders, and executive audiences. * Enable successful transition of innovation solutions into scalable product programs that can be delivered on committed commercial product milestones and launch timelines. **Education & Experience Recommended** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical discipline. * 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, system software, embedded software, firmware, platform engineering, technical program management, or complex hardware/software product development. * Proven experience driving technical solutions from concept or POC through architecture alignment, productization planning, integration, validation, production readiness, and product launch. **Preferred Certifications** Solution Architecture & Productization Leadership * Experience defining solution architecture, feature scope, system boundaries, technical assumptions, and integration models for new technology programs. * Ability to convert early concepts into executable productization plans with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, exit criteria, risks, and launch-readiness requirements. * Experience managing roadmap alignment, agile execution, backlog priorities, release readiness, issue triage, defect tracking, and executive status reporting. Technical Depth, Integration, and Launch Readiness * Strong familiarity with embedded systems, firmware, drivers, operating system interfaces, connectivity, security, manageability, validation, and commercial PC platform integration. * Experience coordinating hardware, firmware, software, validation, manufacturing, and supplier dependencies required to move solutions from lab feasibility into product programs. * Exposure to AI-enabled device experiences, edge AI, device orchestration, intelligent endpoint platforms, or commercial PC innovation is preferred. **Knowledge & Skills** * Deep technical understanding of solution architecture, system integration, embedded platforms, PC architecture, embedded software, drivers, kernel-level software, operating system interfaces, connectivity, security, manageability, and validation practices. * Hands-on knowledge of embedded software and system software development, including C/C++, Python or scripting languages, RTOS or Linux/Windows system concepts, device drivers, firmware interfaces, boot flows, power management, performance optimization, and hardware/software debugging. * Experience with software development lifecycle practices for embedded and system software, including requirements definition, design reviews, source control, CI/CD pipelines, unit and integration testing, defect triage, code quality, security reviews, and release readiness. * Ability to work across low-level platform software and higher-level solution architecture to evaluate technical feasibility, identify integration gaps, debug cross-domain issues, and guide engineering teams toward production-quality implementation. * Strong ability to define scope, structure ambiguous concepts, identify technical gaps, sequence new_jobs.title: Embedded AI/ML Developer
new_jobs.jd: **Description -** The Embedded AI/ML Developer will design, develop, and optimize AI-enabled embedded software solutions for HP’s commercial PC and connected device portfolio. This role focuses on deploying efficient machine learning models at the edge, integrating AI capabilities with firmware and system software, and enabling intelligent user experiences across resource-constrained platforms. The engineer will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and data science teams to translate AI/ML concepts into production-ready embedded implementations. Responsibilities include model optimization, inference runtime integration, performance tuning, debugging, documentation, and staying current with emerging edge AI technologies, tools, and industry best practices. **Responsibilities** * Designs, develops, and optimizes embedded AI/ML software for edge devices, including PCs, docking solutions, displays, peripherals, and other intelligent client platforms. * Converts AI/ML algorithms and proof-of-concept models into efficient, production-quality embedded implementations optimized for latency, memory, power, and compute constraints. * Integrates machine learning inference engines, model runtimes, and AI accelerators into embedded firmware and system software environments. * Collaborates with cross-functional teams to define AI feature requirements, system architecture, data flow, model deployment strategy, and validation plans. * Profiles and tunes embedded AI workloads to improve inference performance, reduce memory footprint, improve responsiveness, and optimize power consumption. * Develops and maintains software interfaces between AI/ML components, firmware, device drivers, sensors, embedded controllers, and host applications. * Supports model compression, quantization, pruning, benchmarking, and deployment using embedded AI frameworks and hardware acceleration technologies. * Troubleshoots complex system-level issues involving AI inference, firmware behavior, sensor data, device communication, and platform integration. * Creates and maintains technical documentation, including architecture descriptions, design specifications, model deployment guides, validation procedures, and integration notes. * Explores emerging embedded AI, TinyML, NPU, MCU, sensor fusion, and edge inference technologies to help drive innovation across future HP platforms. ****Education & Experience** Recommended** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics or a related technical discipline. * 7–10 years of relevant experience in embedded software, firmware, AI/ML deployment, edge inference, or system-level software development. **Preferred Certifications** Embedded AI/ML Engineering * Hands-on experience deploying AI/ML models on embedded systems, edge devices, MCUs, SoCs, NPUs, DSPs, or other constrained compute platforms. * Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, compression, TensorRT, ONNX, TFLite, or similar deployment toolchains. * Strong understanding of ML inference pipelines, data preprocessing, sensor input handling, feature extraction, and runtime performance tuning. * Experience integrating AI workloads with embedded firmware, device drivers, RTOS, Linux, Windows, or low-level system software environments. * Familiarity with AI validation, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, model benchmarking, and regression testing for embedded platforms. Embedded Systems and Platform Integration * Strong embedded software development experience using C/C++ and Python for prototyping, automation, model conversion, and testing. * Experience working with sensors, camera/audio pipelines, telemetry data, wireless modules, or contextual signals used by AI-enabled experiences. * Knowledge of embedded communication protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI, USB, PCIe, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or other device interconnect standards. * Ability to read hardware specifications, device datasheets, schematics, and platform architecture documents to support AI/ML feature integration. **Knowledge & Skills** * Proficient in C/C++ and Python; familiar with embedded scripting, automation, build systems, and model deployment workflows. * Experience with AI/ML frameworks and formats such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorFlow Lite, OpenVINO, or similar toolchains. * Knowledge of embedded system architecture, boot flow, firmware interfaces, memory constraints, power management, and real-time execution tradeoffs. * Skilled in embedded debugging and profiling using JTAG, SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, performance counters, tracing tools, or vendor-specific debug environments. * Experience optimizing AI workloads for latency, throughput, memory footprint, thermal behavior, and battery life on constrained devices. * Familiarity with AI accelerator SDKs, NPU/DSP/GPU offload, heterogeneous compute, and hardware/software co-optimization. * Understanding of RTOS concepts, Linux/Windows system software, multi-threaded development, secure update mechanisms, and production-quality embedded software practices. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to debug complex interactions across model behavior, firmware, drivers, sensors, and host software. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional engineering environment, translating AI concepts into reliable product experiences.
